_comment: Measured pystencil-vs-corpus divergences pinned by test_fixture_conformance.py. Each entry overrides the shared fixture's expectation for pystencil ONLY; the shared fixtures are never edited. Keys are fixture/case names.

zero-width/format characters are strippe.note: browser strips \p{Cf}; pystencil _CONTROLISH covers only [\x00-\x1f\x7f], so zero-width/format characters survive (and Python str.split does not treat them as whitespace)

junk-points-dropped-numeric-strings-coer.note: browser drops junk points; pystencil Point.from_dict coerces every entry (non-dict -> origin, missing coord -> 0, 'NaN' -> float nan, kept as the string 'NaN' here)

field-type-coercion-and-drops.note: browser drops non-string color/fillColor to defaults; pystencil _as_str stringifies them (42 -> '42', false -> 'False')

non-object-line-entries-skipped.note: browser skips non-object line entries; pystencil Line.from_dict turns each into an all-defaults line

empty-input-emits-only-forced-keys.note: browser emits undefined-valued forced keys that drop out on JSON round-trip; pystencil has no undefined — missing dims parse as 0 and export as 0

lines-pass-through-by-reference-unsaniti.note: browser passes lines through by reference; pystencil always re-parses lines (unknown 'junk' key dropped, thickness '9' coerced to 9, defaults filled) — the same-reference assertion has no pystencil equivalent

version-as-numeric-string-accepted.note: browser coerces version '1'; pystencil open_project requires an int version and raises ValueError('unrecognized project-file version')
